basis: The dashboard 'Smartphone Market Share in Europe' displays current market-share values: Apple (45%), Xiaomi (30%), Samsung (15%), and Others (10%). The public rule requires allocating the premium EU retail promotion budget to the brand with the highest current market share. Apple has the highest value at 45%, which is greater than Xiaomi (30%), Samsung (15%), and Others (10%). Therefore, Apple is the current market-share leader and the correct recipient of the budget.
option_label: Select Apple for the premium EU retail promotion budget
